purpose: Capability registry for literature discovery, completeness auditing, TOC retrieval, and website synchronization. The primary literature task must select the newest stable compatible capability on main before each fetch run.
fingerprintMethod: sha256 of newline-joined stable component labels and blob SHAs: literatureAudit, literatureWorkflow, journalRegistry, completenessGuard, tocCollector, publisherFallback

literatureAudit.validation: Workflow-generated audit persisted in commit 7a212252a399abff49ac95978120df0dbc18cb3d at 2026-09-19T06:55:25.883Z with auditVersion=4, 15 target journals, rolling seven-day safety window, sourceRecords=591, criticalSourceFailures=0, sourceFamilyGaps=0, and lateIndexed=3 across Nature/ACS Catalysis.
literatureAudit.comparisonToPriorStable: Prior stable audit blob 2bf18d6df41def88763196c4b0f31c2bcc6f14a7 covered 10 journals, used a rolling three-calendar-day window, queried Crossref online/published only, had no per-journal source-family health, and discarded records whose publication date fell before the rolling window even when they were newly deposited. On the same upgraded seven-day configuration, enabling late-deposit rescue increased the discovered universe from 588 to 591 and surfaced three otherwise missed late-indexed records.
literatureAudit.semanticImpact: Strict recall upgrade. Adds five journals prospectively from 2026-09-19; expands overlap to seven Beijing calendar days; unions Crossref online/published/created with OpenAlex; retains recent Crossref-created deposits back to each journal activeFrom even when publication date predates the rolling window; exposes source agreement and source-family health. Keyword screening remains priority-only and cannot silently remove DOI differences.

literatureWorkflow.validation: The workflow now runs the completeness capability guard before building the DOI-union audit and persisted the post-guard audit report in commit 7a212252a399abff49ac95978120df0dbc18cb3d.
literatureWorkflow.semanticImpact: Prevents silent regression of the 15-journal registry, prospective activation dates, seven-day rescan, Crossref created-date rescue, source-family health reporting, and all-difference review flow.

journalRegistry.validation: 15 canonical target journals are centralized. Chem, Chemical Science, CCS Chemistry, Science Advances, and Chinese Journal of Chemistry have activeFrom=2026-09-19; existing ten journals retain activeFrom=2026-07-01.
journalRegistry.semanticImpact: Prevents duplicated journal lists and prevents the new five journals from being backfilled before 2026-09-19 even when the safety window or late-deposit rescue reaches earlier dates.

completenessGuard.validation: Executed by the literature audit workflow before the report persisted in commit 7a212252a399abff49ac95978120df0dbc18cb3d.
completenessGuard.semanticImpact: CI fails if journal count/list, prospective activation, seven-day overlap, Crossref created-date discovery, late-deposit observability, source-family health, or the no-silent-keyword-exclusion invariant regresses.

websiteMediaSync.validation: GitHub Pages run 35418810801 succeeded with galleryDois=463, workerItems=463, finalRecords=407, failures=0 and figure metadata=716
websiteMediaSync.semanticImpact: Downstream media synchronization coverage only. Adds rolling-supplement.json to media sync; does not alter literature discovery, inclusion decisions, or upstream TOC retrieval.

recentMediaRepair.validation: GitHub Actions run 35419525431 completed successfully on the Sep 18-19 reviewed literature update; it prepared 30 recent gaps, attempted direct publisher retrieval, ran the Worker fallback, verified inventory, and triggered Pages refresh.
recentMediaRepair.effectiveness: Publisher direct retrieval remained blocked by ACS/Wiley 403 and Nature IDP for most targets; the workflow is operationally stable but currently low-yield without an authenticated browser/VPN source.
recentMediaRepair.semanticImpact: TOC/media repair only. Does not change literature discovery or inclusion decisions.
